core_problem_solved: To provide a lightweight and focused library for scanning a Java classpath (JARs and directories) to discover classes that are marked with specific annotations.
key_features: A simple API to define which archives and directories to scan
A mechanism to specify which annotations to search for
Build-time scanning and index generation to speed up runtime discovery
era_and_niche: A small, specialized library from the JBoss ecosystem, used in the late 2000s for annotation-based class discovery, particularly in the context of Java EE application servers and RESTeasy.
reason_for_obsolescence: The library is **obsolete** and no longer maintained. Its functionality has been completely superseded by more powerful, faster, and actively maintained classpath scanning libraries like **`org.reflections:reflections`** and especially the modern standard, **`io.github.classgraph:classgraph`**.
